CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._prix_ou_null(p text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN s.x ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN CASE WHEN s.x::numeric > 0 THEN s.x::numeric END END
    FROM (SELECT replace(replace(regexp_replace(coalesce(p, ''), '[[:space:]]', '', 'g'), chr(160), ''), ',', '.') AS x) s;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public._ts_ou_null(p text)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF p IS NULL OR btrim(p) = '' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;
  RETURN p::timestamptz;
EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
  RETURN NULL;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.annonce_en_retrait_compte_relie(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
      from public.cross_post_jobs j
      join public.comptes_lies c on j.user_id in (c.user_a, c.user_b)
      join public.cross_post_jobs d on d.user_id = (case when c.user_a = j.user_id then c.user_b else c.user_a end)
       and d.platform = j.platform and d.action = 'delete'
     where j.id = p_job
       and (d.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user')
            or (d.status = 'deleted' and d.created_at >= coalesce(j.published_at, j.created_at)))
       and (public.listing_designe(public.annonce_id_de_job(j.platform_listing_id, j.listing_url), d.listing_url, d.platform_listing_id)
            or (nullif(btrim(coalesce(j.listing_url, '')), '') is not null and d.listing_url = j.listing_url)))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.annonce_id_de_job(p_listing_id text, p_listing_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(
    NULLIF(btrim(p_listing_id), ''),
    substring(p_listing_url from '/itm/([0-9]+)'),
    substring(p_listing_url from '/items/([0-9]+)'),
    substring(p_listing_url from '/([0-9]{6,})(?:[/?#]|$)')
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.annonce_id_depuis_url(p_platform text, p_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE lower(COALESCE(p_platform, ''))
    WHEN 'leboncoin' THEN substring(COALESCE(p_url, '') from '/(\d{6,})(?:[/?#]|$)')
    WHEN 'beebs'     THEN substring(COALESCE(p_url, '') from '/p/(\d+)(?:[-/?#]|$)')
    WHEN 'opla'      THEN substring(COALESCE(p_url, '') from '(art_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)')
    WHEN 'depop'     THEN substring(COALESCE(p_url, '') from '/products/([A-Za-z0-9_]+-[A-Za-z0-9-]*[A-Za-z0-9])')
    WHEN 'ebay'      THEN substring(COALESCE(p_url, '') from '/itm/(?:[^/?#]*/)?(\d{9,})')
    ELSE NULL END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.annonce_id_job(p_platform text, p_url text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  select case lower(coalesce(p_platform, ''))
    when 'vinted' then substring(coalesce(p_url, '') from '/items/(\d+)')
    else public.annonce_id_depuis_url(p_platform, p_url)
  end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.annonce_mise_en_ligne(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE(LEAST(
           (SELECT min(LEAST(a.publiee_le, a.created_at)) FROM public.annonces_plateforme a
             WHERE a.user_id = j.user_id AND a.platform = j.platform
               AND a.listing_id = NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '')),
           (SELECT min(LEAST(a.publiee_le, a.created_at)) FROM public.annonces_plateforme a
             WHERE a.user_id = j.user_id AND a.platform = j.platform AND a.job_id = j.id
               AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '') IS NULL),
           CASE WHEN j.platform = 'vinted' AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '') IS NOT NULL THEN
             (SELECT min(s.captured_at) FROM public.vinted_listing_snapshots s
               WHERE s.user_id = j.user_id AND s.vinted_item_id = btrim(j.platform_listing_id)) END,
           j.published_at, j.created_at), j.created_at)
    FROM public.cross_post_jobs j WHERE j.id = p_job;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.armer_retraits_copies(p_inventaire_id bigint, p_chemin text, p_sauf_job uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_sauf_plateforme text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_delai interval DEFAULT '00:00:00'::interval)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_inv   public.inventaire%rowtype;
  v_pub   record;
  v_del   uuid;
  v_n     integer := 0;
  v_pl    text[] := '{}';
  v_url   text;
  v_pf    jsonb;
  v_q     integer := 0;
begin
  select * into v_inv from public.inventaire where id = p_inventaire_id;
  if not found or v_inv.fusionne_dans is not null then
    return jsonb_build_object('armes', 0);
  end if;
  for v_pub in
    select x.id, x.platform from (
      (select distinct on (j.platform) j.id, j.platform
         from public.cross_post_jobs j
        where j.user_id = v_inv.user_id and j.inventaire_id = p_inventaire_id
          and coalesce(j.action, 'publish') in ('publish', 'republish')
          and j.status = 'published'
          and (p_sauf_job is null or j.id <> p_sauf_job)
          and (p_sauf_plateforme is null or j.platform <> p_sauf_plateforme)
          and public.retrait_job_prouve(j.id)
          and public.rattachement_confirme(j.id)
          and public.fiche_annonces_vivantes(p_inventaire_id, j.platform) < 2
        order by j.platform, coalesce(j.published_at, j.created_at) desc, j.created_at desc)
    ) x
  loop
    v_del := public.armer_retrait_job(v_pub.id, p_chemin, p_delai);
    if v_del is not null then
      v_n := v_n + 1;
      v_pl := v_pl || v_pub.platform;
    end if;
  end loop;
  for v_pub in
    select j.id, j.title, j.listing_url, btrim(j.platform_listing_id) as pl
      from public.cross_post_jobs j
     where j.user_id = v_inv.user_id and j.inventaire_id = p_inventaire_id
       and j.platform = 'beebs' and coalesce(j.action, 'publish') = 'publish'
       and j.status = 'failed'
       and coalesce(j.platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'depot_jamais_en_ligne'
       and btrim(coalesce(j.platform_listing_id, '')) ~ '^[0-9]+$'
       and (j.platform_fields #>> '{preuve_identifiant_beebs,methode}') is not null
       and public.rattachement_confirme(j.id)
       and (p_sauf_job is null or j.id <> p_sauf_job)
       and (p_sauf_plateforme is null or p_sauf_plateforme <> 'beebs')
       and v_inv.statut = 'vendu'
       and exists (
         select 1 from public.ventes v
          where v.user_id = j.user_id and v.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id
            and lower(coalesce(v.statut, '')) not in ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled')
            and lower(coalesce(nullif(v.plateforme_code, ''), nullif(v.plateforme, ''), '')) not in ('', 'beebs'))
       and not exists (
         select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs p
          where p.user_id = j.user_id and p.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id and p.platform = 'beebs'
            and coalesce(p.action, 'publish') in ('publish', 'republish') and p.status = 'published')
       and not exists (
         select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs d
          where d.user_id = j.user_id and d.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id and d.platform = 'beebs' and d.action = 'delete'
            and btrim(coalesce(d.platform_listing_id, '')) = btrim(j.platform_listing_id)
            and (d.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user') or d.created_at >= j.created_at))
  loop
    insert into public.cross_post_jobs
      (user_id, inventaire_id, platform, action, status, photo_option, title, listing_url, platform_listing_id, platform_fields)
    values
      (v_inv.user_id, p_inventaire_id, 'beebs', 'delete', 'pending', 'original', v_pub.title,
       coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(v_pub.listing_url, '')), ''), 'https://www.beebs.app/fr/p/' || v_pub.pl), v_pub.pl,
       jsonb_build_object('arme_par', jsonb_build_object(
         'chemin', p_chemin, 'le', now(), 'depot', v_pub.id,
         'pose_par', 'armer_retraits_copies (dépôt Beebs « jamais en ligne », numéro du dépôt)')));
    v_n := v_n + 1;
    v_pl := v_pl || 'beebs'::text;
  end loop;
  if v_n > 0 then
    insert into public.usage_logs (user_id, feature, metadata)
    values (v_inv.user_id, 'retrait_annonces', jsonb_build_object(
      'chemin', p_chemin,
      'plateformes', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(p order by p), '[]'::jsonb) from unnest(v_pl) as p),
      'n_annonces', v_n,
      'n_articles', 1,
      'article_id', v_inv.id::text));
  end if;
  begin
    v_q := public.poser_questions_copies_non_prouvees(p_inventaire_id, p_sauf_job, p_sauf_plateforme, 'vente:' || coalesce(p_chemin, ''));
  exception when others then
    raise warning 'armer_retraits_copies (article %) : question copie non posée : %', p_inventaire_id, sqlerrm;
    v_q := 0;
  end;
  return jsonb_build_object('armes', v_n, 'plateformes', to_jsonb(v_pl), 'questions', v_q);
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.beebs_commande_classe(p_statut text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) LIKE 'WAIT_SELLER_CONFIRM%' THEN 'vente'
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) IN ('CONFIRMED_BY_SELLER', 'WAITING_GENARATING_LABEL_BY_SELLER', 'IN_DELIVERY',
                                           'RETRIEVED_BY_BUYER', 'APPROVED_BY_BUYER') THEN 'vente'
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) LIKE 'LABEL_PRINTED%' THEN 'vente'
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) LIKE 'DELIVERED%' THEN 'vente'
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) LIKE 'SELLER_PAID%' THEN 'vente'
    WHEN upper(coalesce(p_statut, '')) = 'CANCELLED' THEN 'annulee'
    ELSE 'inconnu' END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.coins_awaiting_payment()
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, email text, tier text, canal text, next_grant_at timestamp with time zone, jours_retard integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select p.id,
         p.email,
         case when p.is_business then 'business' when p.is_pro then 'pro' else 'premium' end,
         case when p.stripe_customer_id is not null then 'stripe'
              when p.apple_original_transaction_id is not null then 'apple'
              when p.google_purchase_token is not null then 'google'
              else 'inconnu' end,
         w.next_grant_at,
         extract(day from (now() - w.next_grant_at))::int
  from profiles p
  join coin_wallets w on w.user_id = p.id
  where (p.is_pro or p.is_premium)
    and not coalesce(p.is_comped, false)
    and (p.stripe_customer_id is not null
         or p.apple_original_transaction_id is not null
         or p.google_purchase_token is not null)
    and w.next_grant_at is not null
    and w.next_grant_at < now() - interval '3 days'
    and not (p.cloud_formule is not null
             and p.is_cloud is not true
             and p.cloud_essai_arrete is not true
             and p.cloud_canal is distinct from 'offert'
             and p.cloud_essai_debut is not null and p.cloud_essai_fin is not null
             and p.cloud_essai_debut <= now() and now() < p.cloud_essai_fin)
  order by w.next_grant_at;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compte_signal_ajuster(p_user uuid, p_cle text, p_delta integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  INSERT INTO public.compte_signal AS s (user_id, jobs, maj_le)
  VALUES (p_user, CASE WHEN p_delta > 0 THEN jsonb_build_object(p_cle, p_delta) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END, now())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET
    jobs = CASE
      WHEN s.jobs IS NULL THEN NULL
      WHEN COALESCE((s.jobs ->> p_cle)::int, 0) + p_delta <= 0 THEN s.jobs - p_cle
      ELSE jsonb_set(s.jobs, ARRAY[p_cle], to_jsonb(COALESCE((s.jobs ->> p_cle)::int, 0) + p_delta))
    END,
    maj_le = now();

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.copies_fiche_liee(p_user uuid, p_fiche bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(lien bigint, compte uuid, fiche bigint, job uuid, platform text, mise_en_ligne timestamp with time zone, rang integer, motif_refus text, etat_refus text, partagee boolean)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with jumelles as (
    select f.id as lien, x.compte, x.fiche
      from public.fiches_liees_comptes f
      cross join lateral (select case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.fiche_b else f.fiche_a end as fiche,
                                 case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.user_b else f.user_a end as compte,
                                 case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.user_a else f.user_b end as moi) x
      join public.inventaire i on i.id = x.fiche and i.user_id = x.compte
     where (f.fiche_a = p_fiche or f.fiche_b = p_fiche)
       and x.moi = p_user and x.compte <> p_user
       and public.comptes_sont_lies(p_user, x.compte)
       and i.fusionne_dans is null
       and i.statut is distinct from 'vendu' and not (i.quantite is not null and i.quantite <= 0)
  ), depots as (
    select m.lien, m.compte, m.fiche, j.id as job, j.platform,
           coalesce(j.published_at, j.created_at) as mise_en_ligne, j.created_at as cree,
           case
             when not public.retrait_job_prouve(j.id) or not public.rattachement_confirme(j.id) then 'rattachement_non_confirme'
             when public.fiche_annonces_vivantes(m.fiche, j.platform) >= 2 then 'deux_annonces_vivantes'
             when exists (select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs pj
                           where pj.user_id = p_user and pj.inventaire_id = p_fiche and pj.platform = j.platform
                             and coalesce(pj.action, 'publish') in ('publish', 'republish') and pj.status = 'published'
                             and public.annonce_id_de_job(pj.platform_listing_id, pj.listing_url)
                                   is distinct from public.annonce_id_de_job(j.platform_listing_id, j.listing_url))
               then 'deux_annonces_paire'
           end as refus_preuve,
           case
             when coalesce(j.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal', '') = 'sold' then 'annonce_vendue'
             when exists (select 1 from public.annonces_plateforme a
                           where a.user_id = j.user_id and a.platform = j.platform
                             and (a.job_id = j.id or public.listing_designe(a.listing_id, j.listing_url, j.platform_listing_id))
                             and coalesce(public.leboncoin_transaction_lue(a.transaction_plateforme, a.capture), '') in ('pending', 'sold'))
               then 'achat_en_cours'
             when j.platform = 'opla' and public.opla_sortie_passee() then 'opla_quittee'
             when nullif(btrim(coalesce(j.listing_url, '')), '') is null
              and nullif(btrim(coalesce(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '') is null then 'sans_numero_ni_lien'
           end as refus_etat,
           public.boutique_partagee_compte_relie(p_user, m.compte, j.platform) as partagee
      from jumelles m
      join public.cross_post_jobs j on j.user_id = m.compte and j.inventaire_id = m.fiche
       and coalesce(j.action, 'publish') in ('publish', 'republish') and j.status = 'published'
  )
  select d.lien, d.compte, d.fiche, d.job, d.platform, d.mise_en_ligne,
         case when d.refus_preuve is null
              then (row_number() over (partition by d.fiche, d.platform, (d.refus_preuve is null)
                                       order by d.mise_en_ligne desc, d.cree desc))::integer end as rang,
         coalesce(d.refus_preuve, d.refus_etat) as motif_refus,
         d.refus_etat as etat_refus,
         coalesce(d.partagee, false) as partagee
    from depots d
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.expire_publish_reservations()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r        record;
  v_cnt    integer;
  n_res    integer := 0;
  n_jobs   integer := 0;
  n_nu     integer := 0;
  n_sans   integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR r IN
    SELECT j.id AS job_id, j.reservation_id, COALESCE(c.unit_price, 1) AS unit
    FROM cross_post_jobs j
    JOIN coin_reservations c ON c.id = j.reservation_id
    WHERE j.status = 'needs_user'
      AND c.status = 'held'
      AND j.reservation_settled_at IS NULL
      AND COALESCE(j.published_at, j.created_at) < now() - interval '48 hours'
    FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    UPDATE cross_post_jobs SET
      status = 'cancelled',
      error  = 'Publication abandonnée : une information manquait et la question '
            || 'est restée sans réponse pendant au moins 48 heures. '
            || 'Elle ne compte pas dans tes limites — tu peux relancer '
            || 'cette publication quand tu veux depuis ton Stock.'
    WHERE id = r.job_id;
    n_nu := n_nu + 1;
  END LOOP;

  FOR r IN
    SELECT id FROM coin_reservations
    WHERE status = 'held' AND created_at < now() - interval '30 days'
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    UPDATE cross_post_jobs SET
      status = 'cancelled',
      error = COALESCE(NULLIF(error, ''),
        'Publication jamais exécutée en 30 jours — elle ne compte pas dans tes limites.')
    WHERE reservation_id = r.id AND status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user');
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_cnt = ROW_COUNT;
    n_jobs := n_jobs + v_cnt;
    PERFORM settle_publish_reservation(r.id, 'release', 2147483647, 'expired');
    UPDATE coin_reservations SET expired_at = now() WHERE id = r.id;
    n_res := n_res + 1;
  END LOOP;

  FOR r IN
    SELECT j.id,
      CASE
        WHEN j.inventaire_id IS NOT NULL AND i.id IS NULL THEN 'article_supprime'
        WHEN i.statut = 'vendu' THEN 'article_vendu'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs o
                     WHERE o.user_id = j.user_id AND o.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id
                       AND o.platform = j.platform AND o.id <> j.id
                       AND o.action IN ('publish', 'republish')
                       AND o.status = 'published' AND o.sold_at IS NULL
                       AND NULLIF(trim(o.listing_url), '') IS NOT NULL) THEN 'deja_en_ligne'
        WHEN j.status = 'needs_user' AND GREATEST(j.created_at,
               COALESCE(republish_ts_safe(j.platform_fields, 'derniere_relance_manuelle'), '-infinity'::timestamptz),
               COALESCE(republish_ts_safe(j.platform_fields, 'pending_muet_clos_le'), '-infinity'::timestamptz))
             < now() - interval '14 days' THEN 'attente_14j'
        WHEN j.created_at + make_interval(secs => COALESCE(NULLIF(j.platform_fields ->> 'antirobot_pause_cumul_ms', '')::double precision, 0) / 1000)
               < now() - interval '30 days'
             AND NOT (j.platform = 'vinted' AND compte_en_pause_antirobot(j.user_id)) THEN 'filet_30j'
      END AS motif
    FROM cross_post_jobs j
    LEFT JOIN inventaire i ON i.id = j.inventaire_id
    WHERE j.action = 'publish'
      AND j.status IN ('pending', 'needs_user')
      AND j.reservation_id IS NULL
      AND NULLIF(trim(j.listing_url), '') IS NULL
      AND NULLIF(trim(j.platform_listing_id), '') IS NULL
      AND j.created_at < now() - interval '1 hour'
    FOR UPDATE OF j SKIP LOCKED
  LOOP
    CONTINUE WHEN r.motif IS NULL;
    UPDATE cross_post_jobs SET
      status = 'cancelled',
      error = CASE r.motif
        WHEN 'article_vendu'    THEN 'Publication arrêtée : cet article est vendu.'
        WHEN 'article_supprime' THEN 'Publication arrêtée : cet article n''est plus dans ton stock.'
        WHEN 'deja_en_ligne'    THEN 'Publication arrêtée : cet article est déjà en ligne sur cette plateforme.'
        WHEN 'attente_14j'      THEN 'Cette publication attendait une réponse depuis plus de deux semaines : nous l''avons arrêtée. '
                                  || 'Relance-la depuis la fiche de l''article quand tu veux.'
        ELSE 'Publication jamais exécutée en 30 jours : nous l''avons arrêtée. '
          || 'Relance-la depuis la fiche de l''article quand tu veux.'
      END,
      platform_fields = COALESCE(platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
        'expiree_sans_reservation', jsonb_build_object('at', now(), 'motif', r.motif),
        'erreurs_archivees', COALESCE(platform_fields -> 'erreurs_archivees', '[]'::jsonb)
          || jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object('le', now(), 'statut', status,
               'erreur', left(COALESCE(error, ''), 600), 'par', 'expire_publish_reservations')))
    WHERE id = r.id AND status IN ('pending', 'needs_user');
    IF FOUND THEN n_sans := n_sans + 1; END IF;
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'reservations_expirees', n_res,
    'jobs_annules', n_jobs,
    'needs_user_48h', n_nu,
    'sans_reservation', n_sans
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fiche_jumelle_prouvee(p_user uuid, p_fiche bigint, p_apres timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(jumelle bigint, motif text, photos_communes integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH f AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.vinted_account_id, i.photos
      FROM public.inventaire i
     WHERE i.id = p_fiche AND i.user_id = p_user AND i.fusionne_dans IS NULL
       AND COALESCE(i.quantite, 1) <= 1 AND p_apres IS NOT NULL
  ),
  anciennes AS (
    SELECT btrim(i.vinted_item_id) AS id FROM public.inventaire i
     WHERE i.id = p_fiche AND i.user_id = p_user AND NULLIF(btrim(i.vinted_item_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT btrim(c.platform_listing_id) FROM public.cross_post_jobs c
     WHERE c.inventaire_id = p_fiche AND c.user_id = p_user AND c.platform = 'vinted'
       AND COALESCE(c.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish') AND NULLIF(btrim(c.platform_listing_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ),
  urls_f AS (
    SELECT CASE jsonb_typeof(e) WHEN 'string' THEN e #>> '{}' WHEN 'object' THEN e ->> 'url' END AS url
      FROM f, jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.photos) = 'array' THEN f.photos ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) e
    UNION
    SELECT CASE jsonb_typeof(e) WHEN 'string' THEN e #>> '{}' WHEN 'object' THEN e ->> 'url' END
      FROM public.cross_post_jobs c,
           jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.photos) = 'array' THEN c.photos ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) e
     WHERE c.inventaire_id = p_fiche AND c.user_id = p_user AND COALESCE(c.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish')
  ),
  emp_f AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT pe.dhash::bit(64) AS d
      FROM urls_f u JOIN public.photo_empreintes pe ON pe.url = u.url
     WHERE pe.dhash ~ '^[01]{64}$'
  ),
  cand AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.statut, t.vinted_item_id, t.vinted_status, t.disparu_le, t.photos, t.origine,
           LEAST(t.created_at, t.first_seen_at) AS apparue
      FROM f, public.inventaire t
     WHERE t.user_id = p_user AND t.id <> f.id AND t.fusionne_dans IS NULL
       AND COALESCE(t.quantite, 1) <= 1
       AND (t.origine = 'vinted_sync' OR t.origine LIKE 'releve\_%')
       AND LEAST(t.created_at, t.first_seen_at) > p_apres
       AND (NULLIF(btrim(f.vinted_account_id), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(t.vinted_account_id), '') IS NULL
            OR btrim(t.vinted_account_id) = btrim(f.vinted_account_id))
       AND (t.vinted_item_id IS NULL OR btrim(t.vinted_item_id) NOT IN (SELECT a.id FROM anciennes a))
  ),
  photos_t AS (
    SELECT c.id, u.url, pe.dhash::bit(64) AS d
      FROM cand c
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.photos) = 'array' THEN c.photos ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) x
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE jsonb_typeof(x) WHEN 'string' THEN x #>> '{}' WHEN 'object' THEN x ->> 'url' END AS url) u
      JOIN public.photo_empreintes pe ON pe.url = u.url AND pe.dhash ~ '^[01]{64}$'
  ),
  paires AS (
    SELECT pt.id, pt.url, pt.d AS td, ef.d AS fd
      FROM photos_t pt JOIN emp_f ef ON bit_count(pt.d # ef.d) <= 4
  ),
  communes AS (
    SELECT p.id, LEAST(count(DISTINCT p.url), count(DISTINCT p.fd)) AS n,
           bool_or(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM paires q
                            WHERE q.id = p.id AND q.url <> p.url
                              AND bit_count(q.td # p.td) > 4 AND bit_count(q.fd # p.fd) > 4)) AS deux_differentes
      FROM paires p
     GROUP BY p.id
  ),
  prouvees AS (
    SELECT c.id, c.statut, cm.n
      FROM cand c JOIN communes cm ON cm.id = c.id, f,
           LATERAL (SELECT jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.photos) = 'array' THEN c.photos ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS nt,
                           jsonb_array_length(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(f.photos) = 'array' THEN f.photos ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS nf) k
     WHERE cm.n >= 2 AND cm.deux_differentes AND k.nt >= 2 AND k.nf >= 2 AND 2 * cm.n >= k.nt AND 2 * cm.n >= k.nf
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM public.vinted_listing_snapshots s
              WHERE s.user_id = p_user AND s.vinted_item_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM anciennes a)
                AND s.status = 'active' AND s.captured_at >= c.apparue)
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM public.annonces_plateforme ap
              WHERE ap.user_id = p_user AND ap.inventaire_id = p_fiche
                AND ap.statut_plateforme IN ('en_ligne', 'en_verification')
                AND ap.disparu_le IS NULL AND ap.retiree_le IS NULL AND ap.ignoree_le IS NULL
                AND COALESCE(ap.vu_le, ap.created_at) >= c.apparue
                AND NOT (ap.platform = 'leboncoin'
                         AND COALESCE(public.leboncoin_transaction_lue(ap.transaction_plateforme, ap.capture), '') IN ('pending', 'sold')))
       AND (c.statut = 'vendu'
            OR (c.statut = 'stock'
                AND ((NULLIF(btrim(c.vinted_item_id), '') IS NOT NULL AND c.vinted_status = 'active' AND c.disparu_le IS NULL)
                     OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.annonces_plateforme ap
                                 WHERE ap.user_id = p_user AND ap.inventaire_id = c.id
                                   AND ap.statut_plateforme IN ('en_ligne', 'en_verification')
                                   AND ap.disparu_le IS NULL AND ap.retiree_le IS NULL AND ap.ignoree_le IS NULL))))
  )
  SELECT p.id AS jumelle,
         CASE WHEN p.statut = 'vendu' THEN 'vendu_sous_autre_fiche' ELSE 'deja_en_vente_autre_fiche' END AS motif,
         p.n::integer AS photos_communes
    FROM prouvees p
   WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM prouvees) = 1
     AND (SELECT count(*) FROM communes) = 1
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.inventaire_vente_annulee_retraits()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_vente timestamptz;
begin
  if old.statut = 'vendu' and new.statut = 'stock' then
    select max(j.sold_at) into v_vente
      from public.cross_post_jobs j
     where j.inventaire_id = new.id and j.status = 'sold';
    if v_vente is null then
      begin
        v_vente := nullif(btrim(coalesce(old.date, '')), '')::timestamptz;
      exception when others then
        v_vente := null;
      end;
    end if;
    if v_vente is null then
      return new;
    end if;

    update public.cross_post_jobs
       set status = 'cancelled',
           error = 'Retrait annulé : la vente a été annulée, l''article est de nouveau disponible. Ton annonce reste en ligne.',
           platform_fields = coalesce(platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
             'retrait_annule', jsonb_build_object(
               'le', now(), 'motif', 'vente_annulee', 'vente_du', v_vente,
               'pose_par', 'trigger inventaire_vente_annulee_retraits'))
     where inventaire_id = new.id
       and action = 'delete'
       and status in ('pending', 'needs_user')
       and created_at >= v_vente - interval '10 minutes';

    update public.cross_post_jobs
       set platform_fields = platform_fields || jsonb_build_object(
             'pending_removal', false,
             'pending_removal_eteint', jsonb_build_object('motif', 'vente_annulee', 'at', now()))
     where inventaire_id = new.id
       and platform_fields ->> 'pending_removal' = 'true';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.jumelle_occupe_plateformes(p_user uuid, p_fiche bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(platform text, listing_id text, url text, statut text, compte uuid, fiche bigint)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  with p as (
    select f.fiche_b as fiche, f.user_b as compte from public.fiches_liees_comptes f where f.fiche_a = p_fiche and f.user_a = p_user
    union
    select f.fiche_a, f.user_a from public.fiches_liees_comptes f where f.fiche_b = p_fiche and f.user_b = p_user
  ), vivantes as (
    select a.platform, a.listing_id, a.url, a.statut_plateforme as statut, p.compte, p.fiche, 1 as rang
      from p
      join public.inventaire i on i.id = p.fiche and i.user_id = p.compte and i.fusionne_dans is null
      join public.annonces_plateforme a on a.user_id = p.compte and a.inventaire_id = p.fiche
       and a.disparu_le is null and a.statut_plateforme in ('en_ligne', 'en_verification')
    union all
    select c.platform, public.annonce_id_de_job(c.platform_listing_id, c.listing_url), c.listing_url, c.status, p.compte, p.fiche, 2
      from p
      join public.inventaire i on i.id = p.fiche and i.user_id = p.compte and i.fusionne_dans is null
      join public.cross_post_jobs c on c.user_id = p.compte and c.inventaire_id = p.fiche
       and coalesce(c.action, 'publish') in ('publish', 'republish')
       and (c.status in ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user')
            or (c.status = 'published' and not exists (
                  select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs d
                   where d.user_id = c.user_id and d.inventaire_id = c.inventaire_id and d.platform = c.platform
                     and d.action = 'delete' and d.status = 'deleted'
                     and case when public.annonce_id_de_job(d.platform_listing_id, d.listing_url) is not null
                               and public.annonce_id_de_job(c.platform_listing_id, c.listing_url) is not null
                              then public.annonce_id_de_job(d.platform_listing_id, d.listing_url) = public.annonce_id_de_job(c.platform_listing_id, c.listing_url)
                              else d.created_at > coalesce(c.published_at, c.created_at) end)))
  )
  select distinct on (v.platform) v.platform, v.listing_id, v.url, v.statut, v.compte, v.fiche
    from vivantes v
   where public.boutique_partagee_compte_relie(p_user, v.compte, v.platform)
   order by v.platform, v.rang, v.listing_id
$function$

BEGIN
  IF p_user IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_platform, '')), '') IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_listing, '')), '') IS NULL THEN

  SELECT g.inventaire_id INTO v_inv FROM cross_post_jobs g WHERE g.id = p_garde;
  UPDATE cross_post_jobs o
     SET status = 'cancelled',
         error = 'Ligne close : cette annonce est suivie par ta fiche actuelle (l''article d''origine avait été supprimé '
              || 'du stock). Rien n''a été retiré ni publié.',
         platform_fields = COALESCE(o.platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('ligne_sans_fiche_close',
           jsonb_build_object('le', now(), 'par', COALESCE(p_par, 'inconnu'), 'statut_avant', o.status, 'erreur_avant', o.error,
             'remplacee_par', p_garde, 'fiche', v_inv, 'regle', 'une_ligne_par_annonce_0811'))
   WHERE o.user_id = p_user AND o.platform = p_platform
     AND o.inventaire_id IS NULL
     AND o.status IN ('published', 'pending', 'needs_user')
     AND btrim(o.platform_listing_id) = btrim(p_listing)
     AND o.id IS DISTINCT FROM p_garde
     AND COALESCE(o.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish');
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
  RETURN v_n;
END;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.poser_questions_copies_non_prouvees(p_inventaire_id bigint, p_sauf_job uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_sauf_plateforme text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_source text DEFAULT 'vente'::text)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_inv inventaire%ROWTYPE;
  v_vendu_sur text;
  n integer := 0;
  v_n integer := 0;
  v_vente timestamptz;
  v_unique boolean;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO v_inv FROM inventaire WHERE id = p_inventaire_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR v_inv.fusionne_dans IS NOT NULL OR v_inv.statut IS DISTINCT FROM 'vendu' THEN
    RETURN 0;
  END IF;
  SELECT lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(v.plateforme_code, ''), NULLIF(v.plateforme, ''))) INTO v_vendu_sur
    FROM ventes v
   WHERE v.user_id = v_inv.user_id AND v.inventaire_id = v_inv.id
     AND lower(COALESCE(v.statut, '')) NOT IN ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled')
   ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 1;
  v_vendu_sur := COALESCE(v_vendu_sur, lower(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(v_inv.plateforme, '')), '')));
  SELECT max(public.vente_instant(v.vendu_le, v.date, v.created_at)), count(*) <= 1 INTO v_vente, v_unique
    FROM ventes v
   WHERE v.user_id = v_inv.user_id AND v.inventaire_id = v_inv.id
     AND lower(COALESCE(v.statut, '')) NOT IN ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled');

  INSERT INTO inventaire_doublons (user_id, garde, absorbe, niveau, statut, motif, preuves, source)
  SELECT v_inv.user_id, v_inv.id, v_inv.id, 'probable', 'proposee', 'copie_non_prouvee',
         jsonb_build_object(
           'job', j.id, 'annonce_id', ap.id, 'platform', j.platform,
           'url', COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(ap.url, '')), ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.listing_url, '')), '')),
           'titre', COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(ap.titre, '')), ''), NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.title, '')), ''), v_inv.titre),
           'vendu_sur', v_vendu_sur,
           'rattachement', j.platform_fields -> 'rattachement',
           'rattachement_automatique', NOT public.rattachement_confirme(j.id)),
         left(COALESCE(p_source, 'vente'), 80)
    FROM cross_post_jobs j
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT a.id, a.url, a.titre FROM annonces_plateforme a
       WHERE a.job_id = j.id AND a.user_id = j.user_id AND a.disparu_le IS NULL AND a.retiree_le IS NULL
       ORDER BY (a.listing_id = btrim(COALESCE(j.platform_listing_id, ''))) DESC, a.vu_le DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1) ap ON true
   WHERE j.user_id = v_inv.user_id AND j.inventaire_id = v_inv.id
     AND COALESCE(j.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish') AND j.status = 'published'
     AND (p_sauf_job IS NULL OR j.id <> p_sauf_job)
     AND (p_sauf_plateforme IS NULL OR j.platform <> p_sauf_plateforme)
     AND lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(v_inv.plateforme, ''), '')) <> lower(j.platform)
     AND (v_vendu_sur IS NULL OR v_vendu_sur <> lower(j.platform))
     AND COALESCE(j.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal', '') <> 'sold'
     AND NOT (j.platform = 'opla' AND public.opla_sortie_passee())
     AND (public.fiche_annonces_vivantes(v_inv.id, j.platform) >= 2
          OR (NOT public.retrait_job_prouve(j.id) AND public.fiche_annonces_vivantes(v_inv.id, j.platform) < 2)
          OR NOT public.rattachement_confirme(j.id))
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs d
                      WHERE d.user_id = j.user_id AND d.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id AND d.platform = j.platform
                        AND d.action = 'delete' AND d.status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user'))
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;

  IF v_unique THEN
    INSERT INTO inventaire_doublons (user_id, garde, absorbe, niveau, statut, motif, preuves, source)
    WITH c AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT a.id, a.platform, a.listing_id, a.url, a.titre, a.job_id, a.source_rapprochement
        FROM annonces_plateforme a
        LEFT JOIN cross_post_jobs j ON j.id = a.job_id
       WHERE a.user_id = v_inv.user_id AND a.inventaire_id = v_inv.id
         AND a.disparu_le IS NULL AND a.retiree_le IS NULL AND a.ignoree_le IS NULL
         AND a.statut_plateforme IN ('en_ligne', 'en_verification')
         AND length(btrim(COALESCE(a.listing_id, ''))) >= 4
         AND (p_sauf_job IS NULL OR a.job_id IS DISTINCT FROM p_sauf_job)
         AND (p_sauf_plateforme IS NULL OR a.platform <> p_sauf_plateforme)
         AND lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(v_inv.plateforme, ''), '')) <> lower(a.platform)
         AND (v_vendu_sur IS NULL OR v_vendu_sur <> lower(a.platform))
         AND NOT (a.platform = 'opla' AND public.opla_sortie_passee())
         AND COALESCE(a.quantite, 1) <= 1
         AND COALESCE(a.transaction_plateforme, '') NOT IN ('pending', 'sold')
         AND (v_vente IS NULL OR LEAST(COALESCE(a.publiee_le, a.created_at), a.created_at) <= v_vente)
         AND NOT (j.id IS NOT NULL AND j.status = 'published' AND COALESCE(j.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish')
                  AND ((NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '') IS NULL AND NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(j.listing_url, '')), '') IS NULL)
                       OR public.listing_designe(a.listing_id, j.listing_url, j.platform_listing_id)))
         AND NOT (j.id IS NOT NULL AND j.status = 'cancelled' AND COALESCE(j.platform_fields ->> 'pending_removal', '') = 'true')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs p
                          WHERE p.user_id = a.user_id AND p.platform = a.platform
                            AND COALESCE(p.action, 'publish') IN ('publish', 'republish') AND p.status = 'cancelled'
                            AND p.error IN ('Réponse dans l''app : « je l''ai retirée moi-même » — pas une vente',
                                            'Annonce retirée par le vendeur (confirmé dans l''app)')
                            AND public.retrait_meme_annonce(a.platform, a.listing_id, a.url, p.platform_listing_id, p.listing_url))
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventaire_doublons q
                          WHERE q.user_id = v_inv.user_id AND q.motif = 'copie_non_prouvee' AND q.preuves ->> 'annonce_id' = a.id::text)
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs d
                          WHERE d.user_id = a.user_id AND d.platform = a.platform AND d.action = 'delete'
                            AND (d.status IN ('pending', 'processing', 'needs_user') OR (d.status = 'deleted' AND d.created_at >= a.vu_le))
                            AND public.listing_designe(a.listing_id, d.listing_url, d.platform_listing_id)))
    SELECT v_inv.user_id, v_inv.id, v_inv.id, 'probable', 'proposee', 'copie_non_prouvee',
           jsonb_build_object(
             'annonce_id', c.id, 'platform', c.platform, 'listing_id', c.listing_id,
             'url', NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(c.url, '')), ''),
             'titre', COALESCE(NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(c.titre, '')), ''), v_inv.titre),
             'vendu_sur', v_vendu_sur,
             'portee_par', 'annonce', 'depot', c.job_id,
             'rattachement_automatique', COALESCE(c.source_rapprochement, '') <> 'manuel'),
           left(COALESCE(p_source, 'vente'), 80)
      FROM c
     WHERE NOT public.titre_en_serie(v_inv.user_id, c.titre)
    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_n = ROW_COUNT;
    n := n + v_n;
  END IF;
  RETURN n;
END;
$function$

  SELECT v.prix_vente
    FROM public.ventes_operations o
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(
      CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(o.resultat -> 'ventes_ids') = 'array' THEN o.resultat -> 'ventes_ids' ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) e(vid)
    JOIN public.ventes v
      ON v.id = CASE WHEN e.vid ~ '^[0-9]{1,18}$' THEN e.vid::bigint END AND v.user_id = o.user_id
   WHERE p_user IS NOT NULL
     AND p_platform IS DISTINCT FROM 'ebay'
     AND o.user_id = p_user
     AND o.cle IN (nullif(p_pf ->> 'vente_operation_cle', ''),
                   'annonce:' || p_platform || ':' || nullif(btrim(coalesce(p_listing, '')), ''))
     AND v.prix_vente > 0
   ORDER BY (o.cle = nullif(p_pf ->> 'vente_operation_cle', '')) DESC NULLS LAST, v.id
   LIMIT 1;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.push_trg_ventes()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
declare
  v_pf text;
begin
  begin
    v_pf := public.plateforme_normalisee(coalesce(nullif(btrim(new.plateforme_code), ''), new.plateforme));
    if tg_argv[0] = 'releve' then
      if new.vendu_le is not null and new.vendu_le < now() - interval '24 hours' then return new; end if;
      if new.vendu_le is not null and new.vendu_le > now() + interval '1 hour' then return new; end if;
      if v_pf is null or (new.vendu_le is null and not public.push_plateforme_suivie(new.user_id, v_pf)) then return new; end if;
      if v_pf = 'ebay' and exists (
           select 1 from public.push_ventes o
            where o.user_id = new.user_id
              and o.vente_id is distinct from new.id
              and (o.part_le is not null or o.statut in ('en_envoi', 'envoyee', 'declaree')
                   or (o.statut = 'a_envoyer' and (o.job_id is null or exists (
                         select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs js where js.id = o.job_id and js.status = 'sold'))))
              and (o.cles && array['commande:ebay:' || nullif(btrim(coalesce(new.commande_ref, '')), '')]
                   or (o.job_id is not null and o.cree_le > now() - interval '3 days' and exists (
                         select 1 from public.cross_post_jobs j
                          where j.id = o.job_id and j.user_id = new.user_id and j.platform = 'ebay'
                            and nullif(btrim(coalesce(j.platform_listing_id, '')), '') = nullif(btrim(coalesce(new.annonce_id, '')), '')
                            and (j.platform_fields #>> '{vente_commande_ebay,commande}' = new.commande_ref
                                 or j.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,order_id}' = split_part(new.commande_ref, ':', 1)
                                 or exists (
                                      select 1 from public.ventes_operations r
                                        join public.ventes w on w.user_id = r.user_id
                                         and w.id::text in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(case when jsonb_typeof(r.resultat -> 'ventes_ids') = 'array'
                                                                                                  then r.resultat -> 'ventes_ids' else '[]'::jsonb end))
                                       where r.user_id = new.user_id
                                         and (r.job_id = j.id or r.cle = j.platform_fields ->> 'vente_operation_cle')
                                         and w.id <> new.id
                                         and (w.commande_ref = new.commande_ref
                                              or (w.commande_ref is null
                                                  and coalesce(j.platform_fields #>> '{vente_commande_ebay,commande}',
                                                               j.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,order_id}') is null
                                                  and w.created_at >= coalesce(new.vendu_le, new.created_at) - interval '10 minutes'))))))
                   or (new.inventaire_id is not null and o.cree_le > now() - interval '3 days'
                       and o.cles && array['fiche:' || new.inventaire_id::text]
                       and exists (select 1 from public.inventaire i where i.id = new.inventaire_id and coalesce(i.quantite, 1) <= 1)))) then
        insert into public.usage_logs (user_id, feature, metadata)
        values (new.user_id, 'vente_notification_ecartee', jsonb_build_object(
          'raison', 'parade_ebay_releve', 'plateforme', v_pf, 'vente_id', new.id, 'commande_ref', new.commande_ref,
          'annonce_id', new.annonce_id, 'inventaire_id', new.inventaire_id, 'vendu_le', new.vendu_le));
        return new;
      end if;
      perform public.push_noter(new.user_id, 'commande', v_pf, new.id, new.inventaire_id, null,
        new.commande_ref, new.annonce_id, new.titre, new.prix_vente, new.devise, new.vendu_le, false);
    elsif tg_argv[0] = 'personne' or public.push_declaration_en_cours(new.user_id, new.inventaire_id) then
      perform public.push_noter(new.user_id, 'declaree', v_pf, new.id, new.inventaire_id, null,
        new.commande_ref, new.annonce_id, new.titre, new.prix_vente, new.devise, new.vendu_le, true);
    end if;
  exception when others then
    raise warning 'push_trg_ventes (vente %) : % — vente enregistrée quand même', new.id, sqlerrm;
  end;
  return new;
end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.quota_annonces_consommees(p_user_id uuid, p_cycle timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH borne AS (
    SELECT GREATEST(
      p_cycle,
      to_timestamp(COALESCE((SELECT value FROM coin_config WHERE key = 'quotas_annonces_depuis'), 0))
    ) AS t
  )
  SELECT (
    (SELECT count(*) FROM usage_logs u, borne
      WHERE u.user_id = p_user_id AND u.feature = 'generate_listing'
        AND u.created_at >= borne.t
        AND NOT (COALESCE(u.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_titre', '') = 'true'
                 AND COALESCE(u.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_description', '') = 'true')
        AND NOT (
          u.metadata ? 'inventaire_id' AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM usage_logs prev
            WHERE prev.user_id = u.user_id AND prev.feature = 'generate_listing'
              AND prev.metadata->>'inventaire_id' = u.metadata->>'inventaire_id'
              AND prev.created_at <  u.created_at
              AND prev.created_at >= u.created_at - interval '24 hours'
              AND NOT (COALESCE(prev.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_titre', '') = 'true'
                       AND COALESCE(prev.metadata->>'texte_vendeur_description', '') = 'true')
          )
        ))
    + (SELECT count(*) FROM usage_logs l, borne
        WHERE l.user_id = p_user_id AND l.feature = 'lens'
          AND l.created_at >= borne.t
          AND NOT (l.metadata ? 'unifie'))
  )::int;
$function$

  SELECT COALESCE((

       AND a.platform IN ('leboncoin', 'beebs', 'ebay', 'opla', 'depop')
       AND a.disparu_le IS NULL AND b.disparu_le IS NULL AND a.ignoree_le IS NULL AND b.ignoree_le IS NULL

       AND public.rapprochement_description_cle(a.capture ->> 'description') IS NOT NULL
       AND public.rapprochement_description_cle(a.capture ->> 'description') = public.rapprochement_description_cle(b.capture ->> 'description')
       AND NOT public.rapprochement_description_lot(a.capture ->> 'description', a.titre)
       AND NOT public.rapprochement_description_lot(b.capture ->> 'description', b.titre)
       AND COALESCE(a.quantite, 1) <= 1 AND COALESCE(b.quantite, 1) <= 1
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventaire_doublons d
                        WHERE d.user_id = a.user_id AND d.motif = 'annonce_en_double' AND d.statut = 'refusee' AND d.decide_par = 'utilisateur')
      FROM annonces_plateforme a, annonces_plateforme b WHERE a.id = p_a AND b.id = p_b), false);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rattachement_confirme(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  SELECT COALESCE((
    SELECT (COALESCE(j.platform_fields ->> 'source', '') <> 'releve' AND (j.platform_fields -> 'rattachement') IS NULL)
        OR ((COALESCE(j.platform_fields #>> '{rattachement,par}', '') <> 'auto'
             OR COALESCE(j.platform_fields #>> '{rattachement,import}', '') = 'true'
             OR COALESCE(j.platform_fields #>> '{rattachement,motif}', '') IN ('identifiant_depot_clos', 'photo_identique'))
       AND NOT EXISTS (
             SELECT 1 FROM inventaire_fusions f
              WHERE f.user_id = j.user_id AND f.defait_le IS NULL
                AND COALESCE(f.par, '') NOT IN ('utilisateur', 'utilisateur (doublon proposé)')
                AND COALESCE(f.par, '') NOT LIKE 'regle:identifiant%'
                AND COALESCE(f.par, '') NOT LIKE 'utilisateur:photo\_%'

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.remise_annulee_questions(p_user uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_limite integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_f record; v_n integer := 0;
BEGIN
  FOR v_f IN
    SELECT x.user_id, x.id FROM (
      SELECT DISTINCT i.user_id, i.id
        FROM ventes_supprimees s
        JOIN inventaire i ON i.user_id = s.user_id AND i.vinted_item_id = s.annonce_id
       WHERE s.plateforme_code = 'vinted' AND s.source = 'releve_vinted' AND left(s.motif, 9) = 'commande_'
         AND s.supprimee_le > now() - interval '30 days' AND (p_user IS NULL OR s.user_id = p_user)
         AND i.fusionne_dans IS NULL AND i.statut = 'stock' AND COALESCE(i.vinted_status, '') IN ('sold', 'closed')
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inventaire_doublons q
                          WHERE q.user_id = i.user_id AND q.motif = 'remise_en_ligne_vente_annulee'
                            AND (q.garde = i.id OR q.absorbe = i.id))) x
     ORDER BY random()
     LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limite, 20), 50))
  LOOP
    BEGIN
      IF public.remise_annulee_question_poser(v_f.user_id, v_f.id) IS NOT NULL THEN v_n := v_n + 1; END IF;
    EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
      RAISE WARNING 'remise_annulee_questions : fiche (%, %) : %', v_f.user_id, v_f.id, SQLERRM;
    END;
  END LOOP;
  RETURN v_n;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.republication_annonce_partie(p_user uuid, p_inventaire_id bigint, p_platform text, p_listing_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH lid AS (SELECT NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_listing_id, '')), '') AS id),
  constats AS (
    SELECT GREATEST(x.last_checked_at, x.published_at, x.created_at, x.vu_en_ligne_le) AS depuis
      FROM cross_post_jobs x, lid
     WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.platform = p_platform
       AND public.listing_designe(lid.id, x.listing_url, x.platform_listing_id)
       AND x.status = 'cancelled'
       AND x.error IN ('Réponse dans l''app : « je l''ai retirée moi-même » — pas une vente',
                       'Annonce retirée par le vendeur (confirmé dans l''app)')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT public._ts_ou_null(x.platform_fields #>> '{absence_releves,le}')
      FROM cross_post_jobs x, lid
     WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.inventaire_id = p_inventaire_id AND x.platform = p_platform
       AND jsonb_typeof(x.platform_fields -> 'absence_releves') = 'object'
       AND btrim(COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{absence_releves,listing_id}', '')) = lid.id
       AND btrim(COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{absence_releves,premier}', '')) <> ''
       AND btrim(COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{absence_releves,second}', '')) <> ''
  ),
  verdicts AS (
    SELECT x.platform_fields -> 'annonce_disparue' AS v, x.created_at
      FROM cross_post_jobs x, lid
     WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.inventaire_id = p_inventaire_id AND x.platform = p_platform
       AND NULLIF(trim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = lid.id
       AND jsonb_typeof(x.platform_fields -> 'annonce_disparue') = 'object'
       AND (COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{annonce_disparue,pose_par}', '') LIKE 'handler-watch (%'
            OR COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{annonce_disparue,par}', '') IN ('deux_releves_complets_par_boutique', 'deux_releves_probants'))
       AND COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{annonce_disparue,motif}', '') !~ '« (hidden|draft) »'
  ),
  avant_suivi AS (
    SELECT p_platform = 'leboncoin' AND public.leboncoin_vendu_avant_suivi(p_user, lid.id)
       AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a
                     WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = p_platform AND a.listing_id = lid.id
                       AND a.statut_plateforme = 'en_ligne' AND a.disparu_le IS NULL)
            OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x
                         WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.platform = p_platform
                           AND NULLIF(btrim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = lid.id
                           AND (x.platform_fields ->> 'source' = 'releve'
                                OR x.platform_fields #>> '{rattachement,import}' = 'true'))
                AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x
                         WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.platform = p_platform
                           AND NULLIF(btrim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = lid.id
                           AND x.action IN ('publish', 'republish')
                           AND COALESCE(x.platform_fields ->> 'source', '') <> 'releve'
                           AND COALESCE(x.platform_fields #>> '{rattachement,import}', '') <> 'true'))) AS oui
      FROM lid
  )
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT id FROM lid) IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a, lid
       WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = p_platform AND a.listing_id = lid.id
         AND a.transaction_plateforme = 'sold'
         AND NOT (a.platform = 'leboncoin' AND a.statut_plateforme = 'en_ligne' AND a.disparu_le IS NULL
                  AND public.leboncoin_vendu_avant_suivi(a.user_id, a.listing_id))
         AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT s.oui FROM avant_suivi s), false))
      OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x, lid
       WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.inventaire_id = p_inventaire_id AND x.platform = p_platform
         AND NULLIF(trim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = lid.id
         AND x.status = 'published' AND x.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal' = 'sold'
         AND NOT COALESCE((SELECT s.oui FROM avant_suivi s), false))
      OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM verdicts d
       WHERE COALESCE(d.v ->> 'vendue', '') = 'true' OR COALESCE(d.v ->> 'motif', '') ~* '(vendue|sold)')
    THEN 'annonce_vendue'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM verdicts d
       WHERE NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a, lid
          WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = p_platform AND a.listing_id = lid.id
            AND a.vu_le > COALESCE(public._ts_ou_null(d.v ->> 'at'), public._ts_ou_null(d.v ->> 'le'), d.created_at)))
    THEN 'annonce_partie'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM constats c
       WHERE c.depuis IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
         SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a, lid
          WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = p_platform AND a.listing_id = lid.id
            AND a.vu_le >= c.depuis))
    THEN 'annonce_partie'
    ELSE NULL
  END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.republish_planifiee_candidats(p_user uuid, p_reglage jsonb, p_platform text DEFAULT 'vinted'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(inv_id bigint, item_id text, boutique text, titre text, motif text, rang integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_pf text := lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(p_platform), ''), 'vinted'));
  v_age integer := LEAST(365, GREATEST(7, COALESCE(NULLIF(p_reglage ->> 'age_jours', '')::integer, 30)));
  v_seuil timestamptz;
  v_ordre text := COALESCE(p_reglage ->> 'ordre', 'anciennes');
  v_premier date; v_probant boolean;
BEGIN
  v_seuil := now() - make_interval(days => v_age);

  IF v_pf <> 'vinted' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH base AS (
      SELECT i.id, i.titre, i.prix_vente, d.listing_id, d.mise_en_ligne
      FROM inventaire i
      JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(trim(j.platform_listing_id), ''), NULL) AS listing_id,
               COALESCE(
                 CASE WHEN j.handler_build ~* '^releve-annonces' THEN (
                   SELECT a.publiee_le FROM annonces_plateforme a
                   WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = v_pf
                     AND a.listing_id = NULLIF(trim(j.platform_listing_id), '')
                     AND a.publiee_le IS NOT NULL
                     AND a.publiee_le <= COALESCE(j.published_at, j.created_at)
                   ORDER BY a.publiee_le ASC
                   LIMIT 1) END,
                 COALESCE(j.published_at, j.created_at)) AS mise_en_ligne,
               j.photos
        FROM cross_post_jobs j
        WHERE j.user_id = p_user AND j.inventaire_id = i.id AND j.platform = v_pf
          AND j.action IN ('publish', 'republish') AND j.status = 'published'
          AND NULLIF(trim(j.listing_url), '') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY COALESCE(j.published_at, j.created_at) DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ) d ON true
      WHERE i.user_id = p_user
        AND i.statut = 'stock'
        AND i.disparu_le IS NULL
        AND (
          (jsonb_typeof(d.photos) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(d.photos) > 0)
          OR (
            jsonb_typeof(i.photos) = 'array'
            AND EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(i.photos) a(v)
              WHERE NULLIF(trim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.v) = 'string'
                                     THEN a.v #>> '{}' ELSE a.v ->> 'url' END), '') IS NOT NULL)
            AND (v_pf = 'opla' OR NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(i.photos) a(v)
              WHERE NULLIF(trim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.v) = 'string'
                                     THEN a.v #>> '{}' ELSE a.v ->> 'url' END), '') IS NOT NULL
                AND trim(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.v) = 'string'
                              THEN a.v #>> '{}' ELSE a.v ->> 'url' END)
                    !~ '^https://[a-z0-9]+\.supabase\.co/storage/v1/object/public/'))
          )
        )
        AND d.mise_en_ligne < v_seuil
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x
          WHERE x.inventaire_id = i.id AND x.user_id = p_user AND x.platform = v_pf
            AND x.platform_fields ? (v_pf || '_interdit'))
    ),
    dernier AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (j.inventaire_id)
        j.inventaire_id AS inv, j.status, j.published_at, j.created_at
      FROM cross_post_jobs j
      WHERE j.user_id = p_user AND j.action = 'republish' AND j.platform = v_pf
        AND j.inventaire_id IN (SELECT b.id FROM base b)
      ORDER BY j.inventaire_id, j.created_at DESC
    )
    SELECT b.id, b.listing_id, NULL::text, b.titre,
      CASE
        WHEN d.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'en_cours'
        WHEN d.status = 'needs_user' THEN 'attente_decision'
        WHEN d.status = 'failed' AND d.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'echec_recent'
        WHEN d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'republiee_recemment'
        WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a
           WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = v_pf AND a.listing_id = b.listing_id
             AND a.transaction_plateforme = 'sold')
          OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x
           WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.inventaire_id = b.id AND x.platform = v_pf
             AND NULLIF(trim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = b.listing_id
             AND x.status = 'published' AND x.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal' = 'sold')
        THEN 'annonce_vendue'
        WHEN EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM cross_post_jobs x
           WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.inventaire_id = b.id AND x.platform = v_pf
             AND NULLIF(trim(x.platform_listing_id), '') = b.listing_id
             AND ((x.status = 'published' AND x.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal' = 'unavailable')
                  OR (x.action = 'republish' AND x.platform_fields ? 'annonce_disparue'))
             AND NOT EXISTS (
               SELECT 1 FROM annonces_plateforme a
                WHERE a.user_id = p_user AND a.platform = v_pf AND a.listing_id = b.listing_id
                  AND a.vu_le > COALESCE(public._ts_ou_null(x.platform_fields ->> 'unavailable_since'),
                                         public._ts_ou_null(x.platform_fields #>> '{annonce_disparue,at}'),
                                         x.created_at)))
        THEN 'annonce_introuvable'
        ELSE NULL
      END,
      (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY
         CASE WHEN v_ordre = 'prix' THEN b.prix_vente END DESC NULLS LAST,
         b.mise_en_ligne ASC, b.id ASC))::integer
    FROM base b
    LEFT JOIN dernier d ON d.inv = b.id
    ORDER BY 6;
    RETURN;
  END IF;

  SELECT min(s.captured_on) INTO v_premier FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s WHERE s.user_id = p_user;
  v_probant := v_premier IS NOT NULL AND v_premier <= v_seuil::date;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.vinted_item_id, i.vinted_account_id, i.titre, i.prix_vente, i.vinted_view_count, i.listed_at_guess
    FROM inventaire i
    WHERE i.user_id = p_user
      AND i.statut = 'stock'
      AND i.vinted_item_id IS NOT NULL
      AND i.photos IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_array_length(i.photos) > 0
      AND (i.vinted_status IS NULL OR i.vinted_status NOT IN ('hidden', 'draft'))
      AND i.disparu_le IS NULL
      AND i.listed_at_guess IS NOT NULL
      AND i.listed_at_guess < v_seuil
  ),
  dernier AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (j.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id')
      j.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id' AS item, j.status, j.published_at, j.created_at
    FROM cross_post_jobs j
    WHERE j.user_id = p_user AND j.action = 'republish'
      AND j.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id' IN (SELECT b.vinted_item_id FROM base b)
    ORDER BY j.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id', j.created_at DESC
  ),
  disparues AS (
    SELECT x.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id' AS item,
           max(COALESCE(public._ts_ou_null(x.platform_fields #>> '{annonce_disparue,at}'), x.created_at)) AS le
    FROM cross_post_jobs x
    WHERE x.user_id = p_user AND x.action = 'republish' AND x.platform = 'vinted'
      AND x.platform_fields ? 'annonce_disparue'
      AND x.platform_fields ->> 'vinted_item_id' IN (SELECT b.vinted_item_id FROM base b)
    GROUP BY 1
  ),
  releves AS (
    SELECT trim(r.vinted_user_id) AS boutique, r.started_at
    FROM vinted_sync_runs r
    WHERE r.user_id = p_user AND r.kind = 'dressing' AND r.status = 'done'
      AND r.total_entries IS NOT NULL AND r.total_entries >= 0
      AND r.items_vus >= r.total_entries AND r.items_vus > 0
      AND r.finished_at IS NOT NULL
      AND NULLIF(trim(r.vinted_user_id), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(r.erreur, '') !~* '(\[incomplet\]|disparitions non marquées|n''a pas rendu sa liste)'
      AND r.started_at > now() - interval '60 days'
  ),
  absentes AS (
    SELECT b.vinted_item_id AS item
    FROM base b
    JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT max(s.captured_at) AS le FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s
       WHERE s.user_id = p_user AND s.vinted_item_id = b.vinted_item_id
    ) v ON v.le IS NOT NULL
    WHERE NULLIF(trim(b.vinted_account_id), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND (SELECT count(*) FROM releves rl
            WHERE rl.boutique = trim(b.vinted_account_id)
              AND rl.started_at > v.le + interval '1 minute') >= 2
  ),
  snap AS (
    SELECT s.vinted_item_id AS item, min(s.captured_on) AS premier
    FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s
    WHERE v_probant AND s.user_id = p_user
      AND s.vinted_item_id IN (SELECT b.vinted_item_id FROM base b)
    GROUP BY s.vinted_item_id
  )
  SELECT b.id, b.vinted_item_id, b.vinted_account_id, b.titre,
    CASE
      WHEN d.status IN ('pending', 'processing') THEN 'en_cours'
      WHEN d.status = 'needs_user' THEN 'attente_decision'
      WHEN d.status = 'failed' AND d.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'echec_recent'
      WHEN d.status = 'published' AND d.published_at > now() - interval '24 hours' THEN 'republiee_recemment'
      WHEN v_probant AND sn.premier IS NOT NULL AND sn.premier > v_seuil::date THEN 'observee_trop_recente'
      WHEN (di.item IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s
         WHERE s.user_id = p_user AND s.vinted_item_id = b.vinted_item_id
           AND s.status = 'active' AND s.captured_on > di.le::date))
        OR ab.item IS NOT NULL
      THEN 'annonce_introuvable'
      ELSE NULL
    END,
    (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY
       CASE WHEN v_ordre = 'prix' THEN b.prix_vente END DESC NULLS LAST,
       CASE WHEN v_ordre = 'vues'
            THEN b.vinted_view_count::numeric / GREATEST(1, extract(epoch FROM (now() - b.listed_at_guess)) / 86400)
       END ASC NULLS LAST,
       b.listed_at_guess ASC, b.id ASC))::integer
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN dernier d ON d.item = b.vinted_item_id
  LEFT JOIN snap sn ON sn.item = b.vinted_item_id
  LEFT JOIN disparues di ON di.item = b.vinted_item_id
  LEFT JOIN absentes ab ON ab.item = b.vinted_item_id
  ORDER BY 6;
END;
$function$

 IMMUTABLE

  WITH n AS (

           nullif(regexp_replace(split_part(split_part(btrim(coalesce(p_url_a, '')), '?', 1), '#', 1), '/$', ''), '') ua,

    OR (n.ib ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND n.ua IS NOT NULL AND n.ua ~ ('(^|[^0-9])' || n.ib || '([^0-9]|$)')), false)

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vente_annulee_prouvee(p_user uuid, p_fiche bigint)
 RETURNS timestamp with time zone
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH i AS (
    SELECT x.id, x.user_id, btrim(x.vinted_item_id) AS vid
      FROM public.inventaire x
     WHERE x.id = p_fiche AND x.user_id = p_user AND x.fusionne_dans IS NULL
       AND NULLIF(btrim(x.vinted_item_id), '') IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(x.vinted_status, '') IN ('sold', 'closed')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.ventes v
                        WHERE v.user_id = x.user_id AND (v.inventaire_id = x.id OR v.annonce_id = btrim(x.vinted_item_id)))
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.plateforme_commandes pc
                        WHERE pc.user_id = x.user_id AND pc.inventaire_id = x.id AND pc.etat IS DISTINCT FROM 'annulee')
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.cross_post_jobs j
                        WHERE j.user_id = x.user_id AND j.inventaire_id = x.id AND j.status = 'published'
                          AND j.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal' = 'sold')
  ),
  retirees AS (
    SELECT s.vendu_le FROM i JOIN public.ventes_supprimees s
        ON s.user_id = i.user_id AND s.plateforme_code = 'vinted' AND s.annonce_id = i.vid
       AND s.source = 'releve_vinted' AND left(s.motif, 9) = 'commande_'
     WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.vinted_listing_snapshots x
                        WHERE x.user_id = i.user_id AND x.vinted_item_id = i.vid
                          AND x.status IN ('active', 'reserved', 'hidden') AND x.captured_at > s.supprimee_le)
  ),
  jobs AS (
    SELECT j.sold_at FROM i JOIN public.cross_post_jobs j
        ON j.user_id = i.user_id AND j.inventaire_id = i.id AND j.platform = 'vinted' AND btrim(j.platform_listing_id) = i.vid
     WHERE COALESCE(j.platform_fields, '{}'::jsonb) ? 'vente_annulee_remise'
  ),
  commandes AS (
    SELECT pc.vendue_le FROM i JOIN public.plateforme_commandes pc
        ON pc.user_id = i.user_id AND pc.platform = 'vinted' AND pc.etat = 'annulee'
       AND (pc.inventaire_id = i.id OR btrim(pc.annonce_ref) = i.vid)
  )
  SELECT GREATEST((SELECT max(r.vendu_le) FROM retirees r), (SELECT max(j.sold_at) FROM jobs j), (SELECT max(c.vendue_le) FROM commandes c))
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM retirees) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jobs) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM commandes));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vente_apres_mise_en_ligne(p_job uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
  WITH j AS (SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.inventaire_id, c.platform, public.annonce_mise_en_ligne(c.id) AS mise_en_ligne
               FROM public.cross_post_jobs c WHERE c.id = p_job)
  SELECT EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM j JOIN public.ventes v ON v.user_id = j.user_id AND v.inventaire_id = j.inventaire_id
            WHERE lower(COALESCE(v.statut, '')) NOT IN ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled')
              AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.plateforme_code, ''), NULLIF(v.plateforme, '')) IS NOT NULL
              AND lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(v.plateforme_code, ''), NULLIF(v.plateforme, ''))) <> lower(j.platform)
              AND public.vente_instant(v.vendu_le, v.date, v.created_at) > j.mise_en_ligne)
      OR EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM j
             JOIN public.fiches_liees_comptes f ON f.fiche_a = j.inventaire_id OR f.fiche_b = j.inventaire_id
             JOIN LATERAL (SELECT CASE WHEN f.fiche_a = j.inventaire_id THEN f.fiche_b ELSE f.fiche_a END AS fiche,
                                  CASE WHEN f.fiche_a = j.inventaire_id THEN f.user_b ELSE f.user_a END AS uid,
                                  CASE WHEN f.fiche_a = j.inventaire_id THEN f.user_a ELSE f.user_b END AS moi) x ON true
             JOIN public.ventes v ON v.inventaire_id = x.fiche AND v.user_id = x.uid
            WHERE public.comptes_sont_lies(x.moi, x.uid)
              AND lower(COALESCE(v.statut, '')) NOT IN ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled')
              AND COALESCE(NULLIF(v.plateforme_code, ''), NULLIF(v.plateforme, '')) IS NOT NULL
              AND lower(COALESCE(NULLIF(v.plateforme_code, ''), NULLIF(v.plateforme, ''))) <> lower(j.platform)
              AND public.vente_instant(v.vendu_le, v.date, v.created_at) > j.mise_en_ligne);
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.vente_prouvee_fiche_liee(p_fiche bigint, p_platform text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select exists (
    select 1
      from public.fiches_liees_comptes f
      join lateral (select case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.fiche_b else f.fiche_a end as fiche,
                           case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.user_b else f.user_a end as uid,
                           case when f.fiche_a = p_fiche then f.user_a else f.user_b end as moi) x on true
      join public.inventaire i on i.id = x.fiche and i.user_id = x.uid
      join public.ventes v on v.inventaire_id = x.fiche and v.user_id = x.uid
     where (f.fiche_a = p_fiche or f.fiche_b = p_fiche)
       and public.comptes_sont_lies(x.moi, x.uid)
       and i.statut = 'vendu'
       and lower(coalesce(v.statut, '')) not in ('annule', 'annulée', 'cancelled', 'canceled')
       and coalesce(nullif(v.plateforme_code, ''), nullif(v.plateforme, '')) is not null
       and lower(coalesce(nullif(v.plateforme_code, ''), nullif(v.plateforme, ''))) <> lower(coalesce(p_platform, '')))
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(job_id uuid, user_id uuid, inventaire_id bigint, platform text, listing_id text, preuve text, preuve_le timestamp with time zone, prix numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

         coalesce(CASE WHEN c.platform_fields ->> 'detected_price' ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                       THEN (c.platform_fields ->> 'detected_price')::numeric END,
                  c.price,
                  CASE WHEN c.platform_fields ->> 'prix_recreation' ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                       THEN (c.platform_fields ->> 'prix_recreation')::numeric END,
                  CASE WHEN c.platform_fields #>> '{republish_snapshot,prix}' ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$'
                       THEN (c.platform_fields #>> '{republish_snapshot,prix}')::numeric END)
    FROM cross_post_jobs c
    JOIN inventaire i ON i.id = c.inventaire_id AND i.user_id = c.user_id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT x.preuve, x.preuve_le FROM (
        SELECT 'releve_vinted_sold'::text AS preuve,
               (SELECT min(s2.captured_at) FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s2
                 WHERE s2.user_id = c.user_id AND s2.vinted_item_id = btrim(c.platform_listing_id)
                   AND s2.status = 'sold' AND s2.captured_at >= coalesce(c.published_at, c.created_at)) AS preuve_le
         WHERE c.platform = 'vinted'
           AND (SELECT s.status = 'sold' AND s.captured_at >= coalesce(c.published_at, c.created_at)
                  FROM vinted_listing_snapshots s
                 WHERE s.user_id = c.user_id AND s.vinted_item_id = btrim(c.platform_listing_id)
                 ORDER BY s.captured_at DESC LIMIT 1)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'page_annonce_sold'::text,
               coalesce(_ts_ou_null(c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,observed_at}'),
                        _ts_ou_null(c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,lu_le}'),
                        _ts_ou_null(c.platform_fields ->> 'unavailable_since'), c.last_checked_at)
         WHERE c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,listing_id}' = btrim(c.platform_listing_id)
           AND c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,platform}' = c.platform
           AND c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,state}' = 'sold'
           AND c.platform_fields #>> '{sale_evidence,exact}' = 'true'
      ) x
      WHERE x.preuve_le IS NOT NULL
      ORDER BY x.preuve_le
      LIMIT 1
    ) p
   WHERE c.status = 'published' AND (c.platform_fields ->> 'sale_signal') = 'sold'
     AND c.action IN ('publish', 'republish')
     AND (p_user IS NULL OR c.user_id = p_user)
     AND (p_job IS NULL OR c.id = p_job)
     AND nullif(btrim(c.platform_listing_id), '') IS NOT NULL
     AND i.statut = 'stock' AND coalesce(i.quantite, 1) > 0 AND i.fusionne_dans IS NULL
     AND p.preuve_le >= p_depuis
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventes_operations o
                      WHERE o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.cle = 'annonce:' || c.platform || ':' || btrim(c.platform_listing_id))
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventes_operations o
                      WHERE o.user_id = c.user_id AND o.cle = c.platform_fields ->> 'vente_operation_cle')
      AND (p_ignorer_refus OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ventes_prouvees_refus r
                                                 WHERE r.job_id = c.id AND r.reessayer_apres > now()))
   ORDER BY p.preuve_le, c.id
   LIMIT greatest(1, least(coalesce(p_limite, 25), 1000));
$function$
